_help: 19 real queries across 4 quadrants with a ~60/40 train/validation split. Near-misses steer away from commit_artifacts (docs freezes), /code-implement (fixing red gates), and hand-merging to main (which Maestro never does).

queries.query: merge this subsystem branch into the integration branch
open the integration PR into main for human review
ship the redirect-resolver subsystem now that its gates are green
raise the final integration to main pull request for the run
this subsystem is done, land it on the integration branch
open a PR for the finished issue branch and merge it if everything's green
we're finished, put up the big PR so a human can merge to main
close out this subsystem by delivering its branch
get this branch merged into integration once the proof passes
freeze the PRD and commit it to the integration branch
queries.note: docs freeze is commit_artifacts.py, not a PR/merge

queries.query: the RED-lock gate is failing, fix the implementation
queries.note: fixing a red gate is /code-implement; ship refuses to merge red

queries.query: write a conventional commit message tagged with the issue number
queries.note: commit message authoring, not opening/merging a PR

queries.query: merge the integration branch into main for me
queries.note: Maestro never merges to main; that is the human's merge

queries.query: cut the subsystem worktrees from the integration branch
sync the PRD user stories into GitHub issues
create the subsystem tracking issues from the traceability matrix
run the mechanical gate suite for this subsystem
implement the link-store module against its frozen spec
